verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: מַה־ אַתֶּם֙ לָּכֶ֗ם הַזֶּ֔ה מֹֽשְׁלִים֙ אֶת־ הַמָּשָׁ֣ל עַל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אָבוֹת֙ יֹ֣אכְלוּ בֹ֔סֶר וְשִׁנֵּ֥י הַבָּנִ֖ים תִּקְהֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ’at·tem lā·ḵem haz·zeh mō·šə·lîm ’eṯ- ham·mā·šāl ‘al- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ’ā·ḇō·wṯ yō·ḵə·lū ḇō·ser wə·šin·nê hab·bā·nîm tiq·he·nāh
verses.literal: What do you people mean by quoting this proverb - - about the land of Israel . . . The fathers have eaten sour grapes and the teeth of the children are set on edge

verses.original: אָ֕נִי חַי־ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אִם־ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם ע֗וֹד מְשֹׁ֛ל הַזֶּ֖ה הַמָּשָׁ֥ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nî ḥay- nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- yih·yeh lā·ḵem ‘ō·wḏ mə·šōl haz·zeh ham·mā·šāl bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As surely as I live declares the Lord GOD you will no . . . longer quote this proverb in Israel

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כָּל־ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לִ֣י הֵ֔נָּה כְּנֶ֧פֶשׁ הָאָ֛ב וּכְנֶ֥פֶשׁ הַבֵּ֖ן הֵ֑נָּה לִי־ הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת׃ס
verses.transliteration: hên kāl- han·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ lî hên·nāh kə·ne·p̄eš hā·’āḇ ū·ḵə·ne·p̄eš hab·bên hên·nāh lî- han·ne·p̄eš ha·ḥō·ṭêṯ hî ṯā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Behold every soul belongs to Me both father [and] son are Mine The soul who sins is the one who will die

verses.original: כִּי־ וְאִ֖ישׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’îš yih·yeh ṣad·dîq wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Now suppose a man is righteous and does what is just and right

verses.original: לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל אֶל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א וְעֵינָיו֙ אֶל־ גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֶת־ לֹ֣א טִמֵּ֔א רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ אֵ֤שֶׁת לֹ֥א יִקְרָֽב׃ וְאֶל־ אִשָּׁ֥ה נִדָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: lō ’ā·ḵāl ’el- he·hā·rîm lō nā·śā wə·‘ê·nāw ’el- gil·lū·lê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- lō ṭim·mê rê·‘ê·hū ’ê·šeṯ lō yiq·rāḇ wə·’el- ’iš·šāh nid·dāh
verses.literal: He does not eat at the mountain [or] look . . . to the idols of the house of Israel - He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or approach a woman during her period

verses.original: לֹ֣א יוֹנֶ֔ה וְאִישׁ֙ יָשִׁ֔יב חֲבֹלָת֥וֹ חוֹב֙ לֹ֣א יִגְזֹ֑ל גְּזֵלָ֖ה יִתֵּ֔ן לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב יְכַסֶּה־ וְעֵירֹ֖ם בָּֽגֶד׃
verses.transliteration: lō yō·w·neh wə·’îš yā·šîḇ ḥă·ḇō·lā·ṯōw ḥō·wḇ lō yiḡ·zōl gə·zê·lāh yit·tên laḥ·mōw lə·rā·‘êḇ yə·ḵas·seh- wə·‘ê·rōm bā·ḡeḏ
verses.literal: He does not oppress another but restores the pledge to the debtor He does not commit robbery but gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִתֵּ֗ן בַּנֶּ֣שֶׁךְ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔ח וְתַרְבִּית֙ יָד֑וֹ מֵעָ֖וֶל יָשִׁ֣יב יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֱמֶת֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yit·tên ban·ne·šeḵ lō yiq·qāḥ wə·ṯar·bîṯ yā·ḏōw mê·‘ā·wel yā·šîḇ ya·‘ă·śeh ’ĕ·meṯ miš·paṭ bên ’îš lə·’îš
verses.literal: He does not engage in usury [or] take excess interest but he withholds his hand from iniquity . . . [and] executes true justice between men . . .

verses.original: יְהַלֵּ֛ךְ בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֧י אֱמֶ֑ת שָׁמַ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י הוּא֙ צַדִּ֥יק חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hal·lêḵ bə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay ’ĕ·meṯ šā·mar la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ū·miš·pā·ṭay hū ṣad·dîq ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: He follows My statutes and faithfully keeps . . . My ordinances [That man] is righteous surely he will live . . . declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְהוֹלִ֥יד פָּרִ֖יץ בֵּן־ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ דָּ֑ם וְעָ֣שָׂה אָ֔ח מֵאַחַ֖ד מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·lîḏ pā·rîṣ bên- šō·p̄êḵ dām wə·‘ā·śāh ’āḥ mê·’a·ḥaḏ mê·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Now suppose [that man] has a violent son who sheds blood or does . . . any of these [things]

verses.original: וְה֕וּא אֶת־ עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י כָּל־ לֹ֣א אֵ֖לֶּה גַ֤ם אָכַ֔ל וְאֶת־ אֶל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ טִמֵּֽא׃ רֵעֵ֖הוּ אֵ֥שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ’eṯ- ‘ā·śāh kî kāl- lō ’êl·leh ḡam ’ā·ḵal wə·’eṯ- ’el- he·hā·rîm ṭim·mê rê·‘ê·hū ’ê·šeṯ
verses.literal: though the father - has done . . . none . . . of them Indeed the son eats - at the mountain and defiles his neighbor’s wife

verses.original: הוֹנָ֔ה עָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ גְּזֵל֣וֹת גָּזָ֔ל לֹ֣א יָשִׁ֑יב חֲבֹ֖ל נָשָׂ֣א עֵינָ֔יו וְאֶל־ הַגִּלּוּלִים֙ עָשָֽׂה׃ תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hō·w·nāh ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn gə·zê·lō·wṯ gā·zāl lō yā·šîḇ ḥă·ḇōl nā·śā ‘ê·nāw wə·’el- hag·gil·lū·lîm ‘ā·śāh tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh
verses.literal: He oppresses the poor and needy he commits robbery . . . and does not restore a pledge He lifts his eyes to idols he commits abominations

verses.original: נָתַ֛ן בַּנֶּ֧שֶׁךְ לָקַ֖ח וְתַרְבִּ֥ית וָחָ֑י לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֗ה אֵ֣ת עָשָׂ֔ה כָּל־ הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַתּוֹעֵב֤וֹת מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת דָּמָ֖יו יִהְיֶֽה׃ בּ֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯan ban·ne·šeḵ lā·qaḥ wə·ṯar·bîṯ wā·ḥāy lō yiḥ·yeh ’êṯ ‘ā·śāh kāl- hā·’êl·leh hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ mō·wṯ yū·māṯ dā·māw yih·yeh bōw
verses.literal: He engages in usury and takes excess interest Will [this son] live He will not . . . - Since he has committed all these abominations he will surely die . . . his blood will be on his own head

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ הוֹלִ֣יד בֵּ֔ן וַיַּ֕רְא אֶת־ כָּל־ חַטֹּ֥את אָבִ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּרְאֶ֕ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כָּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh hō·w·lîḏ bên way·yar ’eṯ- kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ ’ā·ḇîw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·yir·’eh wə·lō ya·‘ă·śeh kā·hên
verses.literal: Now suppose [this son] has a son who sees - all the sins his father - has committed considers them and does not do likewise . . .

verses.original: לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל עַל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א וְעֵינָיו֙ אֶל־ גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת־ לֹ֥א טִמֵּֽא׃ רֵעֵ֖הוּ אֵ֥שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: lō ’ā·ḵāl ‘al- he·hā·rîm lō nā·śā wə·‘ê·nāw ’el- gil·lū·lê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- lō ṭim·mê rê·‘ê·hū ’ê·šeṯ
verses.literal: He does not eat at the mountain [or] look . . . to the idols of the house of Israel - He does not defile his neighbor’s wife

verses.original: לֹ֣א הוֹנָ֔ה וְאִישׁ֙ חָבָ֔ל חֲבֹל֙ לֹ֣א גָזָ֑ל וּגְזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א נָתָ֔ן לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב כִּסָּה־ וְעֵר֖וֹם בָֽגֶד׃
verses.transliteration: lō hō·w·nāh wə·’îš ḥā·ḇāl ḥă·ḇōl lō ḡā·zāl ū·ḡə·zê·lāh lō nā·ṯān laḥ·mōw lə·rā·‘êḇ kis·sāh- wə·‘ê·rō·wm ḇā·ḡeḏ
verses.literal: He does not oppress another or retain a pledge . . . or commit robbery . . . He gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing

verses.original: הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ מֵעָנִ֞י לָקָ֔ח לֹ֣א נֶ֤שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית֙ ה֗וּא עָשָׂ֔ה מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י הָלָ֑ךְ בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֖י לֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת אָבִ֖יו בַּעֲוֺ֥ן חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hê·šîḇ yā·ḏōw mê·‘ā·nî lā·qāḥ lō ne·šeḵ wə·ṯar·bîṯ hū ‘ā·śāh miš·pā·ṭay hā·lāḵ bə·ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay lō yā·mūṯ ’ā·ḇîw ba·‘ă·wōn ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: He withholds his hand {from harming} the poor and takes no interest or usury He keeps My ordinances and follows My statutes Such a man will not die for his father’s iniquity He will surely live . . .

verses.original: אָבִ֞יו מֵ֖ת בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃ כִּֽי־ עָ֣שַׁק עֹ֗שֶׁק גָּזַל֙ גֵּ֣זֶל אָ֔ח עָשָׂ֖ה וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ ט֛וֹב בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמָּ֑יו וְהִנֵּה־
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇîw mêṯ ba·‘ă·wō·nōw kî- ‘ā·šaq ‘ō·šeq gā·zal gê·zel ’āḥ ‘ā·śāh wa·’ă·šer lō- ṭō·wḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·māw wə·hin·nêh-
verses.literal: As for his father he will die for his own iniquity because he practiced extortion robbed . . . his brother and did what was wrong . . . among his people . . .

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַדֻּ֛עַ הַבֵּ֖ן לֹא־ נָשָׂ֥א בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֑ב וְהַבֵּ֞ן עָשָׂ֗ה אֵ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּצְדָקָ֣ה שָׁמַ֛ר וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם כָּל־ חֻקּוֹתַ֥י חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem mad·du·a‘ hab·bên lō- nā·śā ba·‘ă·wōn hā·’āḇ wə·hab·bên ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh šā·mar way·ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām kāl- ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: Yet you may ask Why shouldn’t the son . . . bear the iniquity of his father Since the son has done - what is just and right carefully observing - all My statutes he will surely live . . .

verses.original: הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֣יא תָמ֑וּת בֵּ֞ן לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֣א׀ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֗ב וְאָב֙ לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הַבֵּ֔ן צִדְקַ֤ת הַצַּדִּיק֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה עָלָ֣יו וְרִשְׁעַ֥ת רָשָׁע תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃ס עָלָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: han·ne·p̄eš ha·ḥō·ṭêṯ hî ṯā·mūṯ bên lō- yiś·śā ba·‘ă·wōn hā·’āḇ wə·’āḇ lō yiś·śā ba·‘ă·wōn hab·bên ṣiḏ·qaṯ haṣ·ṣad·dîq tih·yeh ‘ā·lāw wə·riš·‘aṯ rå̄·šå̄ʿ tih·yeh ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: The soul who sins is the one who will die A son will not bear the iniquity of his father and a father will not bear the iniquity of his son The righteousness of the righteous man will fall upon him and the wickedness of the wicked man will fall upon him

verses.original: כִּ֤י וְהָרָשָׁ֗ע יָשׁוּב֙ מִכָּל־ חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַר֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקּוֹתַ֔י וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: kî wə·hā·rā·šā‘ yā·šūḇ mik·kāl ḥaṭ·ṭå̄·ṯō ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·šā·mar ’eṯ- kāl- ḥu·qō·w·ṯay wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins - he has committed keeps - all My statutes and does what is just and right he will surely live . . . he will not die

verses.original: כָּל־ לֹ֥א פְּשָׁעָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה יִזָּכְר֖וּ ל֑וֹ בְּצִדְקָת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- lō pə·šā·‘āw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh yiz·zā·ḵə·rū lōw bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: None . . . of the transgressions - he has committed will be held against him Because of the righteousness - he has practiced he will live

verses.original: הֶחָפֹ֤ץ אֶחְפֹּץ֙ מ֣וֹת רָשָׁ֔ע נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֲל֛וֹא בְּשׁוּב֥וֹ מִדְּרָכָ֖יו וְחָיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: he·ḥā·p̄ōṣ ’eḥ·pōṣ mō·wṯ rā·šā‘ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hă·lō·w bə·šū·ḇōw mid·də·rā·ḵāw wə·ḥā·yāh
verses.literal: Do I take any pleasure in . . . the death of the wicked declares the Lord GOD Wouldn’t I prefer that he turn from his ways and live

verses.original: צַדִּ֤יק וּבְשׁ֨וּב מִצִּדְקָתוֹ֙ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל כְּכֹ֨ל עָשָׂ֧ה הַתּוֹעֵב֜וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ הָרָשָׁ֛ע יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה וָחָ֑י כָּל־ לֹ֣א צִדְקָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂה֙ תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה מָעַ֛ל בְּמַעֲל֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ וּבְחַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ חָטָ֖א יָמֽוּת׃ בָּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq ū·ḇə·šūḇ miṣ·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh ‘ā·wel kə·ḵōl ‘ā·śāh hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·šer- hā·rā·šā‘ ya·‘ă·śeh wā·ḥāy kāl- lō ṣiḏ·qå̄·ṯō ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ṯiz·zā·ḵar·nāh mā·‘al bə·ma·‘ă·lōw ’ă·šer- ū·ḇə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- ḥā·ṭā yā·mūṯ bām
verses.literal: But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity committing the same abominations as the wicked . . . will he live . . . None of the righteous acts - he did will be remembered Because of the unfaithfulness - - and sin - he has committed he will die

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן שִׁמְעוּ־ נָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲדַרְכִּי֙ לֹ֣א יִתָּכֵ֔ן הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem de·reḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāy lō yit·tā·ḵên šim·‘ū- nā bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hă·ḏar·kî lō yit·tā·ḵên hă·lō ḏar·ḵê·ḵem lō yit·tā·ḵê·nū
verses.literal: Yet you say The way of the Lord is not just Hear now O house of Israel Is it My way that is unjust . . . Is it not your ways that are unjust . . .

verses.original: צַדִּ֧יק בְּשׁוּב־ מִצִּדְקָת֛וֹ וְעָ֥שָׂה עָ֖וֶל וּמֵ֣ת עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם יָמֽוּת׃ס בְּעַוְל֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq bə·šūḇ- miṣ·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh ‘ā·wel ū·mêṯ ‘ă·lê·hem yā·mūṯ bə·‘aw·lōw ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity he will die for this He will die because of the iniquity - he has committed

verses.original: רָשָׁ֗ע וּבְשׁ֣וּב מֵֽרִשְׁעָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה ה֖וּא אֶת־ יְחַיֶּֽה׃ נַפְשׁ֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ ū·ḇə·šūḇ mê·riš·‘ā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·ya·‘aś miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh hū ’eṯ- yə·ḥay·yeh nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: But if a wicked man turns from the wickedness - he has committed and does what is just and right he - will save his life

verses.original: וַיִּרְאֶ֣ה וַיָּשׁוֹב מִכָּל־ פְּשָׁעָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה חָי֥וֹ יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’eh way·yå̄·šōḇ mik·kāl pə·šā·‘āw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ḥā·yōw yiḥ·yeh lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions - he had committed he will surely live . . . he will not die

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן הַדְּרָכַ֞י לֹ֤א יִתָּֽכְנּוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mə·rū de·reḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāy lō yit·tā·ḵên had·də·rā·ḵay lō yit·tå̄·ḵən·nū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hă·lō ḏar·ḵê·ḵem lō yit·tā·ḵên
verses.literal: Yet the house of Israel says The way of the Lord is not just Are My ways unjust O house of Israel Is it not your ways that are unjust . . .

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ט אֶתְכֶם֙ אִ֨ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֜יו נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה שׁ֤וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ מִכָּל־ פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם עָוֺֽן׃ וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם לְמִכְשׁ֖וֹל
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’eš·pōṭ ’eṯ·ḵem ’îš kiḏ·rā·ḵāw nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh šū·ḇū wə·hā·šî·ḇū mik·kāl piš·‘ê·ḵem ‘ā·wōn wə·lō- yih·yeh lā·ḵem lə·miḵ·šō·wl
verses.literal: Therefore O house of Israel I will judge you each according to his ways declares the Lord GOD Repent and turn from all your transgressions so that your iniquity will not become your downfall

verses.original: הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ פִּשְׁעֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֣ם בָּ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם חָדָ֖שׁ לֵ֥ב חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְר֣וּחַ וְלָ֥מָּה תָמֻ֖תוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: haš·lî·ḵū mê·‘ă·lê·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- piš·‘ê·ḵem ’ă·šer pə·ša‘·tem bām wa·‘ă·śū lā·ḵem ḥā·ḏāš lêḇ ḥă·ḏā·šāh wə·rū·aḥ wə·lām·māh ṯā·mu·ṯū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Cast away from yourselves - all the transgressions - you have committed and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit Why should you die O house of Israel

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּמ֣וֹת הַמֵּ֔ת נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהָשִׁ֖יבוּ וִֽחְיֽוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî lō ’eḥ·pōṣ bə·mō·wṯ ham·mêṯ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hā·šî·ḇū wiḥ·yū
verses.literal: For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death . . . declares the Lord GOD So repent and live
